structured_output.what_is_happening: A 35-minute-old pump.fun token, GROKBOTIFY ("Grokbotification"), is trading on PumpSwap. It was created at unix 1790147919 and migrated 71 seconds later (1790147990). A migration that fast almost always means the bonding curve was bought out by a coordinated or bundled buy at launch. Since then it has done about $255k volume against about $36k liquidity (h1 turnover ~7x). Price is up about 240–260% in the hour, market cap is about $177k, and all-time high is about $190k. GeckoTerminal counts about 903 unique buyers and 662 unique sellers. Buys and sells are roughly balanced. GT shows 5-minute volume at about $11.7k, versus about $79k over 15 minutes, which suggests the burst is already slowing. However, DexScreener's 5-minute window shows about $35k, so the data sources disagree. GMGN flags 170 bundler wallets, and the top bundler traders account for about 51.5% of trading. Graph analysis finds a 31-wallet insider network linked by transfers. There are 20 snipers. The creator has closed out ("creator_close", 0 balance). The token is marked as a community takeover. The only social link is a single X status from the account Multi_Serio_Ai. There is no website and no Telegram. At least 10 other tokens named "Grokbotification" exist, some created about 2 days earlier and several in the same hour. All of them are dead at $3–7k market cap.

authenticity.evidence: Bonding curve completed in about 71 seconds. GMGN flags 170 bundler wallets, and top bundler traders account for 51.5% of trading. A 31-wallet insider network is linked by transfers. There are 20 sniper wallets. The creator has fully exited. The token is labeled a community takeover, a label often put on after the dev leaves. Buy and sell counts are almost equal, which fits wash or rotation trading. GMGN page visits are very low (12), which suggests little outside attention. There are no paid DexScreener boosts or ads.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN bundler tags can overcount on fast pump.fun launches. The 903 unique buyers could include real retail. I have no X data to check whether the phrase is actually trending.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a bundled pump.fun launch that migrated in about 71 seconds, riding a Grok-flavored name that has already been launched more than 10 times. Bundlers dominate trading, a 31-wallet insider cluster exists, the creator has exited, and the only social link is a single X post. The 35-minute spike to about $177k is most likely the insiders' distribution phase. The base case is a fade over the next few hours, unless outside viral attention for the phrase shows up.
